schema:name: Accurate and timely reconciliation statements.
schema:description:
These are periodic financial reports that compare the claims submitted by healthcare providers against the actual payments made by the payer. They identify and resolve any discrepancies in a standardized, efficient, and transparent manner.

They provide financial transparency and closure for both payers and providers at the end of every billing period. Accurate reconciliation prevents the accumulation of unresolved debts and ensures that all financial accounts are properly balanced.

Example: A monthly statement provided to a hospital that clearly explains the status of every submitted claim and any applied deductions.
